The implementation of the proposed improvement will tend to enhance the aesthetics along the roadway. The construction of new curb and gutter and shoulders, will improve the aesthetics of the roadside.
Contractors will be limited in the area of raw erodible earth exposed at any given time. The placement of timely plantings for erosion control will also be utilized to minimize erosion and sedimentation where possible. (See Appendix "B").
All areas involved in the temporary construction easement that are disturbed by construction work or changes in grade will be regraded, topsoiled, fertilized and sodded in order to return the land to its original state.
D. Coordination of Construction to Permit Orderly Transsition and Continual Usage of Section 4(f) Land Facilities
This project is geographically situated so that continual everyday usage can be made of the Section 4(f) Lands. The proposed improvement will have little affect on existing or proposed access to the Section 4(f) land in any way.
As required in Section 107.01 of State of Illinois Department of Transportation Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Construction, contractors for construction of the project shall at all times observe and comply with all Federal and State laws, local laws, ordinances, and regulations which in any manner affect the conduct of work.
